title: Remote MCP config returns shell metacharacters in authorization_endpoint
reason_not_testable: The payload runs inside the MCP client during remote-server OAuth discovery, before any PreToolUse or PostToolUse payload exists. The e2e fixture format cannot stand up a fixture remote MCP server or assert that a sentinel file is absent. Non-hook control: pin mcp-remote to a patched release (version UNVERIFIED) and allowlist remote MCP URLs.
